Completion-gated restart or weighted selection is the supported purpose. Successful installation is qualified by -1, valid metadata, assertion exhaustion and retry liveness.

The TU data-flow summary is supported. Flag assignment, like playback initialization, is conditional on x590; unconditional flag installation is specifically not accepted. Dynamics precedes selected flags.
Active callers verify standing Wait, sustained SquatWait and Rebirth maintenance; RebirthWait also uses it.
The three interfaces and logical sentinel/weight consumption are supported. No compiled pair size or union equivalence is retained.
The complete implementation supports the shared predicate, installation and completion-gated selection purpose.
The proposed TU state_behavior write preserves verified branches and adds unchecked-index, malformed-weight, retry-liveness, sentinel and dynamics-ordering qualifications.

baseline_record.why: The translation unit owns the shared completion check, weighted variant selection, and animation-installation operations that realize wait-animation cycling.

link_dispositions.reason: The TU implements completion-gated cycling. Actual frame-completion detection is delegated.

baseline_record.why: The function waits for animation completion and then restarts the current animation or installs a weighted wait-animation variant.

link_dispositions.reason: Canonical completion-gated behavior and active Wait/SquatWait consumers support the relation.

baseline_record.why: The routine performs the common animation-resource, script, dynamics, blend, and playback installation used when a wait animation is restarted or replaced by a weighted variant.

link_dispositions.reason: Restart calls this helper; weighted replacement duplicates its installation sequence rather than calling it. The duplicate relation remains separately accounted for.
